result.description: Howe Farming  Howe Farming Enterprises Pty Ltd is seeking a full-time Production Engineer to support the design, operation, optimisation and maintenance of high-volume packing shed and production systems used for bananas, avocados, coffee and other tropical produce at our Queensland sites.  This role is responsible for improving plant performance, equipment reliability, production flow, quality outcomes and safe operating standards across post-harvest and packing operations. The successful candidate will work closely with operations and maintenance teams to enhance efficiency, reduce downtime and support continuous improvement across multiple processing and packing activities.   Key responsibilities include:  - Planning, directing and coordinating production engineering activities for packing sheds and production lines.  - Analysing production schedules, equipment utilisation, downtime trends and operational data to improve throughput, efficiency and cost effectiveness.  - Reviewing packing line layouts, material flow and process bottlenecks, and recommending engineering improvements to plant and systems.  - Developing specifications for equipment, plant modifications, process upgrades, line expansions and new installations.  - Coordinating installation, commissioning, testing and modification of machinery and plant equipment.  - Establishing and maintaining standards and procedures for installation, inspection, maintenance, testing and quality control.  - Carrying out inspections of machinery, plant and associated systems to ensure optimum performance and reliability.  - Directing and coordinating planned, preventive and corrective maintenance programs to minimise production disruptions.  - Working with site teams to identify root causes of equipment failure, reduce waste and improve productivity.  - Supporting workplace health and safety compliance, risk controls and safe operating practices across production and maintenance activities.  - Preparing reports, technical documentation, maintenance plans and recommendations for capital works and process improvement initiatives.  To be successful in this role, you will have:  - A bachelor degree or higher qualification in production engineering, mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering or a related engineering discipline.  - At least 3 years of relevant experience in production, plant, manufacturing, food processing, packaging or industrial operations.  - Experience with automated or semi-automated production lines, conveyors, grading systems, packing equipment or industrial plant machinery.  - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess equipment performance and production data.  - Knowledge of preventive maintenance systems, quality standards, engineering documentation and workplace safety requirements.  - Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across operations, engineering and maintenance teams.  Desirable:  - Experience in horticulture, fresh produce packing, food manufacturing or agricultural processing environments.  - Experience in plant layout planning, process improvement, automation or controls.  This is an excellent opportunity to join a progressive agricultural business and contribute to reliable, efficient and high-quality production systems in a dynamic regional operation. UNI-SPAN HEIGHT SAFETY PTY LTD is the Australian entity of the broader Uni-Span Group, a specialist in formwork and scaffolding solutions for construction and infrastructure projects. Operating since at least 2006, the company provides and hires out Quickstage scaffolding systems, custom formwork solutions, and engineering support, serving industries such as civil, commercial, and power generation.

We are seeking skilled and qualified Scaffolders to join our team in NSW and QLD.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Determining job requirements and planning/configuring scaffolding
Undertake checking and assessing activities of scaffold prior to, during and at the completion of each build
Erecting lifting tackles by attaching pulleys and blocks to fixed overhead structures, and installing cables and attaching counterweights
Attaching slinging gear to hoisting equipment and objects to be moved using clamps, hooks, bolts and knots
Fitting and bolting tubes, support braces and components to form bases and build up scaffolding
Lifting and positioning sections of scaffolding
Carry out tasks within agreed time limits
Dismantling and removing on completion
Carry out tasks within agreed time limits
Fixing mesh and reinforcing steel into position in formwork for concrete pours
Setting up winches and rigging equipment to raise and position girders, plates, columns and other steel units
Erecting guard rails, guy wires, ropes and clears, laying planks and hanging safety nets
Help identify hazards, defects and the need for adjustment or repair; to ensure compliance with agreed codes, law, working practices and health and safety
Maintain accurate records of inspection and hand over
Where possible, rectify identified defects, failures, errors or omissions to scaffold structures. If not possible ensure reporting to the required personnel and restrict access to structure until such time the defect is rectified
Adhere to all organisational and customer policies, procedures and Safety Health Management System requirements
Ensure all scaffold, temporary works and other scaffold related activities are undertaken in accordance with Australian Standards and the relevant states Code of Practice

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Demonstratable working experience of at least 3 years in a similar role within the Construction and Maintenance industries
High Risk Work Licence (SB, SI or SA)
Proven experience erecting, maintaining and dismantling Scaffolding structures in the Port, Coal, Construction and Maintenance industries
Working at Heights Competency
Confined Space Entry Competency
Gas Test Atmospheres Competency
Coal Board Medical and Standard 11 Induction Competency
Desirable: Any or combination of Work Platform (WP), Forklift Truck (LF), Intermediate Rigger (RI), Dogger (DG) or Non-Slew Crane (CN) High Risk Work Licence/s
Construction Industry Induction – Blue/White Card
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Strong commitment to hassle free customer service
Strong commitment to health, safety, environment and compliance standards
Willingness to work extended hours, shift work or hours as required to achieve positive outcomes
Desire to lead a highly driven team to achieve successful outcomes for both the customer and in turn, MI Scaffold
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
